olivia.h: FYI vendor kickoff Fri 10:00 PT. Final scope: KMS presign flow, ephemeral RBAC, audit->SIEM <=5m.

rahul.k: RBAC change window: 09:00-11:00 PT (2h). Need named approvers + rollback owner.

sam.t: Use assessor-ephemeral pipeline, presign TTL=15m, S3 prefix pen-tests/exports/. Ops reserve 4h retest window 7 days post-fix and keep snapshots 72h.

jin.w: Tested presign on staging. Lambda uses kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext + kms:Sign. We will NOT grant kms:Decrypt to assessor principals. I'll publish a runbook snippet and a CloudTrail query to check for Decrypt events.

ops-bot: [ephemeral-bake] scheduled: ephemeral/assessor-bake-2026-05-05T07:00Z -> expires 2026-05-05T11:00Z.

rahul.k: Intake: vendor findings -> intake form -> create GH issue on pen-2026-q2. Add labels: requires-kms-review, rbac. If kms+high -> page KMS SME.

jin.w: I'll create the form + webhook and post runbook link today. Runbook will include keystorectl snapshot steps and CloudTrail validation: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=assessor-vendor | jq '.Events[] | select(.EventName=="Decrypt")'

olivia.h: IR note: active exploit = escalate to oncall-SOC and open #incidents; that path bypasses normal retest. Final owners: Jin (runbook+form), Rahul (escalation+labels), Sam (retest+snapshots).
